title: The license, still up
logline: The fishing license and the ticket, framed in 2001, on a kitchen wall in 2023. The man in waders, old now, at his own table, out of focus. Ticket on top. Still.

panels.composition: A kitchen wall, close: the two-window frame from 2001 — the 1988 license, the pink citation above it — the glass a little dusty, hung slightly crooked. Below and behind, soft: an old man at a kitchen table with a mug, the waders long gone, looking at nothing in particular. Morning light. The frame is the only thing sharp.

characters.pose: an old man at a table, soft focus

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a close view of a slightly crooked two-window frame on a kitchen wall holding an old fishing license with a pink citation mounted above it, and softly behind it an old man sitting at a kitchen table with a mug in morning light, no words
